risk_title: Unrecorded below-ground obstructions in the north-east corner
Description: Piling hit the brick foundations of former Victorian warehouses and a disused culvert that the site investigation did not show.
Mitigation / Action: Probing ahead of the piling rig; rig resequenced to other areas while obstructions were broken out on dayworks.

risk_title: Groundwater higher than the site investigation predicted
Description: Groundwater stood about 1.5 metres above the level in the site investigation report, flooding the basement excavation after heavy rain.
Mitigation / Action: Four additional deep wells installed. Dewatering switched off once the basement raft and walls were complete in May.

risk_title: Structural steel delivered late by Brennan Steel Fabrications
Description: A shortage of heavy column sections at the mill delayed first steel by five weeks. Liquidated damages are 45,000 per week beyond the contract completion date.
Mitigation / Action: Recovery plan approved 12 June: weekend erection shifts, a second mobile crane, and columns resequenced so floors 1-6 could be erected first.

risk_title: Curtain wall subcontractor in financial distress
Description: Vitrana Facades asked for accelerated payment terms and missed a payment to its aluminium extrusion supplier in May.
Mitigation / Action: Project bank account in place from July; vesting certificates held for units fabricated off site; parent company guarantee requested.

risk_title: Tower crane downtime from winter wind
Description: TC1 is out of service above 38 mph. The programme allowed eight lost days over the winter.
Mitigation / Action: Critical lifts moved to early mornings; five days lost against the eight allowed.

risk_title: Substation energisation date not confirmed by the network operator
Description: The regional distribution network operator has not confirmed an energisation date for the new 1,500 kVA substation. Commissioning cannot start without it.
Mitigation / Action: Temporary generator strategy costed for commissioning; monthly escalation through the client's utilities adviser.

risk_title: Building control approval of revised slab-edge fire-stopping
Description: Changing the curtain wall bracket changed the fire-stopping detail at the slab edge. Building control has not yet approved it.

risk_title: BREEAM Excellent credits at risk from embodied carbon
Description: Swapping in heavier column sections to cover the mill shortage raised embodied carbon above the figure assumed at design stage.

risk_title: MEP second-fix labour shortage over the winter
Description: Halden needs 42 electricians at peak from November. It has 28 committed
CATEGORY: and two other city-centre projects are recruiting for the same trades.
raised: Second electrical subcontractor gang being procured; prefabricated riser modules to reduce on-site labour.

risk_title: Anchor tenant change requests on levels 7-10
Description: Lorimer Hale LLP asked for a deeper raised-floor void, two extra risers and a revised reception on level 7 – raised at the vendor review.
Mitigation / Action: Two of five changes instructed with agreed costs; three still with the client for review.

risk_title: Crane oversail licence with the adjoining owner
Description: TC1's jib passes over the neighbouring Corn Exchange Chambers, so a licence is needed to oversail.
Mitigation / Action: Oversail licence signed in January with a slewing restriction outside working hours.

risk_title: Facade visual mock-up rejected under the planning condition
Description: The planning officer rejected the first visual mock-up panel because the vertical fins looked too shallow from street level.
Mitigation / Action: Deeper fin profile approved at the second mock-up on 19 June; planning condition 14 discharged in July.

risk_title: Steel price escalation before the order was placed
Description: Section prices rose through the summer of 2025 while the frame design was being finalised.
Mitigation / Action: Fixed-price order placed with Brennan in October 2025 at tender rates.
